会议室内，刘济民认真听着梁晓生的想法，其余人也做思考状。梁晓生可能是想到了自己的出身，越说越激动。
梁晓生能说出这样的话，刘济民是一点都不觉得奇怪。
《包氏父子》拍摄结束后，曾经召开过讨论会，在会议上梁晓生就大谈批判错了重点，导演谢铁骊也当场回呛，导致会议结束后，梁晓生走在路上都不敢跟谢铁骊碰头。
还是谢铁骊主动搭话，梁晓生才主动放下了芥蒂，从此更加支持谢铁骊的作品。
“济民，你怎么看？”于蓝挥挥手让神情激动的梁晓生坐下。
梁晓生唾沫横飞，听到于蓝的话自觉有点失态，毕竟自己只是一个还没入门的新编辑。
“不好意思，刚才想到了我的情况，我情绪有点激动。济民同志，你不要介意。如果我说的不对，大家见谅。”梁晓生小心翼翼地坐了下来，正襟危坐，神色带着一丝不安。
见刘济民沉默没有说话，梁晓生暗道坏事了，自己应该私下说才对。刘济民同志该不会以为自己是故意拿他当垫脚石，出风头吧？
梁晓生真想向刘济民发誓，自己绝对没这个念头，不是心机男。
对于梁晓生这种从小敏感、自卑的人来说，此刻脑补出来的故事已经不亚于第二次世界大战了。
终于，刘济民开口了。
“其实对于知识分子来说，总喜欢在作品里批判点什么，好似不批判就不是好作品。但是批判了就是对的吗？我看不一定，所以我们要批判我们的批判。
但是批判我们的批判就对了吗？我看也不一定，所以我们还是要批判批判的批判。”
刘济民在众人愕然、茫然、不解的目光中，顿了顿，缓口气幽幽说道：“不过最终批判什么，我还是想听听于大姐的意见，也就是领导的意见！”
于蓝听完这席话，心中只有一个念头，卧槽，这年轻人！
“济民同志，没想到你还是个哲学家！”于蓝脸上神情变幻，笑容里带着一丝无奈，也可能是无语。
梁晓生见刘济民开口，心中的大石头才终于落了地。不过又一个念头浮上心头，不听我的？

In the conference room, Liu Jimin listened carefully to Liang Xiaosheng's thoughts, and the others were also thinking. Liang Xiaosheng may have thought of his own origin, and the more he talked, the more excited he became.
Liu Jimin didn't find it strange at all that Liang Xiaosheng could say such things.
After the filming of "Bao and Sons" ended, a discussion meeting was held. At the meeting, Liang Xiaosheng criticized the film for having missed the point. Director Xie Tieli also responded with a backlash on the spot. As a result, after the meeting, Liang Xiaosheng did not dare to meet Xie Tieli while walking on the road.
It was Xie Tieli who took the initiative to talk to him, and Liang Xiaosheng took the initiative to put aside his grudge and supported Xie Tieli's works even more.
"Jimin, what do you think?" Yu Lan waved his hand and asked the excited Liang Xiaosheng to sit down.
Liang Xiaosheng salivated and felt a little out of sorts after hearing Yu Lan's words. After all, he was just a new editor who had not yet started.
"I'm sorry, I just thought about my situation and I got a little emotional. Comrade Jimin, don't mind. If what I said is wrong, please forgive me." Liang Xiaosheng sat down cautiously, sitting upright with a hint of uneasiness in his expression.
Seeing that Liu Jimin was silent and didn't say anything, Liang Xiaosheng secretly thought that something bad had happened and he should have said it in private. Comrade Liu Jimin shouldn't think that he is deliberately using him as a stepping stone to gain limelight, right?
Liang Xiaosheng really wanted to swear to Liu Jimin that he never had this idea and was not a scheming man.
For people like Liang Xiaosheng who have been sensitive and have low self-esteem since childhood, the story that comes to mind at this moment is no less than World War II.
Finally, Liu Jimin spoke.
"In fact, intellectuals always like to criticize something in their works, as if if they don't criticize, it's not a good work. But is it right if it is criticized? I don't think so, so we have to criticize our criticism.
But is it right to criticize our criticism? I don’t think so, so we still have to criticize and criticize. "
Liu Jimin paused for a moment under everyone's stunned, confused, and puzzled gazes, then took a breath and said quietly: "But in the end, I still want to hear Sister Yu's opinion, that is, the leader's opinion!"
After hearing this, Yu Lan had only one thought in his mind, damn, this young man!
"Comrade Jimin, I didn't expect you to be a philosopher!" The expression on Yu Lan's face changed, with a hint of helplessness in his smile, or maybe he was speechless.
When Liang Xiaosheng saw Liu Jimin speaking, the big stone in his heart finally fell to the ground. But another thought came to mind, don't you listen to me?
